note: Per-market funnel of screen names plus paper-book holdings. Classification is diagnostic — it does not run the deferred per-holding state machine. Experiments are the position-lifecycle catalog, joined to the unified assessment ledger when present. Switch market (and paper track) rather than stacking every universe on one board.

columns.label: Not buy tier
columns.question: Names currently below buy / strong_buy — census, not the watch cut.

experiments.question: What conviction floor keeps losers out without starving the book?
Does a research-accumulate gate improve entry quality?

columns.label: Not now
columns.question: Buy-tier names blocked by timing wait this cycle.

experiments.question: Does wait-timing block a new buy?

columns.label: Near buy threshold
columns.question: Ready buy-tier (not waiting) plus hold names at the pre-buy conviction floor.

experiments.question: How aggressively should we start a sleeve?

columns.label: Just bought
columns.question: First capital is on the book — starter sleeve or a recent first fill.

experiments.question: What fraction of the sleeve should the first fill take?
Does splitting the decided notional across weekday/weekly tranches cut peak adverse exposure, and which cadence wins?
Pause remaining tranches if MAE exceeds a band while thesis intact?

columns.label: Growth
columns.question: Held names adding toward or sitting at the target sleeve.

experiments.question: Calendar DCA vs discretionary top-up — same overlay as starter.
Add remaining tranches only when mark ≤ first fill?
If a harvest/tactical skim fires during build, pause remaining tranches or recycle proceeds only when the mark is below the first fill? Do not lot-link blocks — net after costs is the gate.
experiments.revisit_when: entry_dca_overlay ready_for_cadence_analysis AND graduated harvest skims occur during open starter/build windows

experiments.question: Skip remaining adds when hypothesis integrity is weakening/broken?
How long may a sleeve stay below target before we stop adding?
How far from target before we trim or top up?
What share of intact underwater names is acceptable?
Does a mark drawdown break the facts, or only the price?

columns.label: Near sell threshold
columns.question: Harvest, grace, or exit-pending — still held, leaving or skimming.

experiments.question: What urgency threshold starts a harvest skim?
Minimum unrealized gain before skimming?
How many confirm screens before a rules exit?
Does a momentum-grace overlay cut bad exits?
Should an intact thesis dampen exit urgency?

columns.label: Just sold
columns.question: Position closed on a recent mark — rotate, recover, or cut.

experiments.question: Rotate broken-thesis losers first?
Only rotate when swap_score clears 2× round-trip cost?
How long before a sold name may re-enter?

columns.label: Post sale monitor
columns.question: Cooldown / recommit watch after a cycle — not a remaining DCA tranche.

experiments.question: Can we keep first-entry cadence evidence uncontaminated by tagging recommit episodes separately?
Does the previous cycle's result (winner/loser/thesis) change whether we recommit?
Should a second cycle use a smaller starter than the first?
Allow a second trigger to add beyond the original sleeve while still held?
experiments.revisit_when: conviction_weighted_sizing active AND first-entry cadence ranked
